subject: Write and run the Ljung-Box residual test -- decision gate G1
description:
THE PLAN'S NAMED GATE (task_plan.md G1). No Ljung-Box code exists anywhere in the repo -- verified by repo-wide grep. It must be written.

Source: Hyndman & Athanasopoulos 5.4 (residual diagnostics), made precise by 5.3 (fitted values and residuals) -- both already in SCAN_LOG.md.

Reads the four persisted models at 05_thesis_results/05_model_benchmark/models/{CSD,danskvand,energidrikke,RTD}/ (CSD+danskvand are model.json XGBoost, energidrikke+RTD are model.joblib -- handle both).

OUTCOME DECIDES SCOPE:
  Residuals show remaining autocorrelation -> the 2.B feature additions (STL strength, remainder ACF, Fourier) are justified
  Residuals are white noise -> SKIP 2.B entirely. Do the 2.A repairs anyway; they are correctness fixes, not enhancements. A negative result here is itself reportable and costs nothing.

Free: no retrain, no API spend.
